Text-to-speech with explicit MP3 response format

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let request_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"input":"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.","model":"tts-1-hd","response_format":"mp3","speed":1.0,"voice":"nova"}"#).unwrap();
    let request = serde_json::from_value(request_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.speech(request).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
